summary: This dataset describes a study on cone-rod dystrophy (CORD) caused by pathogenic variants in the CFAP410 gene. A 6-year-old boy with decreased vision underwent ocular examinations, including fundus imaging, SS-OCT, and systemic X-ray checks, and was found to have macular staphyloma and thinning of the outer retina. The study identified two heterozygous missense pathogenic variants, c.319 T > C and c.347 C > T, in exon 4 of the CFAP410 gene, which affected cell cycle, protein stability, and ubiquitination levels in HEK293T cells.
